products.name: MCP Connectors by Databox
products.tagline: Give your AI Analyst context to explain performance and act
products.description: Connect your AI Analyst to the tools your business runs on. It pulls context from your CRM or support desk, so every answer reflects what's happening in your business, and it can act on what it finds. Choose from 10+ connectors or add any MCP server.

products.name: SaleSmartly
products.tagline: Turn conversations across every channel into customers
products.description: SaleSmartly brings customer conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, Telegram, LINE, WeChat and more into one workspace. Manage leads with a built-in CRM, let AI agents answer questions and qualify customers 24/7, translate conversations in real time, and automate follow-ups—all while your team keeps the context needed to turn more conversations into customers.

products.name: Statable Analytics
products.tagline: Web analytics built for you and your AI agents
products.description: Statable is web analytics built for humans and AI agents. Use the simple dashboard yourself, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and other agents through MCP to read reports, analyze traffic, and configure tracking, goals, and funnels. No cookies, no analytics consent banner in most cases, and your data stays hosted in the EU.

products.name: Vitals 
products.tagline: A Mac activity monitor that thinks in apps, not processes
products.description: Activity Monitor lists a thousand processes, a hundred of them called Google Chrome Helper. Vitals adds every helper to the app that launched it, so you see 60 apps instead of 1,000 processes, each with one figure for memory, CPU, energy, disk and network. It keeps 30 days of history, alerts you when an app misbehaves, finds forgotten dev servers, and shows temperatures, fans and battery. Every readout can sit in your menu bar, arranged your way. Pay once. No subscription, no account.

products.name: VibeDefend by CybeDefend
products.tagline: The one command line to secure your Cursor and Claude Code
products.description: VibeDefend installs on your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Codex and more) with one command. From then on the agent writes with your business rules, mined from your repo, and your security rules in its context. It scans each diff while the file is still open, and a guard refuses rm -rf, sudo or a read of your secrets before it runs. Scanners check code after the commit, this runs before the line is written. Free plan, no card.

products.name: Okara
products.description: Okara is an AI CMO. Enter your website and it studies your product, competitors and brand voice, then runs 10+ agents for SEO, AI search, Reddit, X, LinkedIn, creators and UGC video. You approve every draft and it publishes. Used by 100,000+ businesses.

products.name: GenCode
products.tagline: A coding agent inside the Genspark Super App
products.description: GenCode is Genspark’s coding agent with Chat and Terminal UIs. It supports models from Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more, and works directly on code in a directory you choose.

products.name: Shotcandy
products.description: Paste a screenshot. Get something lovely. Shotcandy is a free screenshot beautifier that turns plain screenshots into beautiful, share-ready images and videos in seconds, right in your browser.

products.name: Microsoft Copilot
products.description: The new Copilot connects the tools people rely on with the next generation of capabilities they’ll need to build, customize and scale AI across work. Copilot connects with your work content and the apps you already use, bringing together the latest AI models to help you create finished work, not just answers.

products.name: Dina 4.5
products.tagline: Beautiful screen recordings, screenshots, and 3D motion
products.description: Record your screen, capture beautiful screenshots, add cinematic 3D motion and perspective, customize every detail, and share instantly with a link. Dina 4.5 brings screen recordings, screenshots, 3D animations, and sharing into one fast, beautifully designed workflow.

products.name: Stash
products.description: Stash gives your Mac hidden controls that feel like they’ve always belonged there. Beautiful, native-feeling and ridiculously satisfying to use - adjust system controls with tactile sliders and dials, manage windows, and keep your favourite apps within reach through a hidden expandable dock and app launcher. Stash Deck extends the experience to your iPhone, turning it into a tactile remote for your Mac with quick controls, app launching and configurable widgets.

products.name: Ryu Journal
products.tagline: A journal to help busy minds let go
products.description: Ryu means "flow" in Japanese. That's the whole idea. Ryu Journal is a quiet place to put a thought down and let it go. No accounts, no social feed, no pressure — just you and the page. Open it, write what's on your mind, and get back to your day. WRITE, THEN LET GO A clean, distraction-free editor. Tap the plus, write, save. Tap any entry to keep writing. Your week gathers softly into one simple timeline.

products.name: MuM
products.tagline: A reading-first Markdown engine for macOS
products.description: Your Markdown lives in a dozen folders. Most of the time you don't want to write — you just want to read one section. Every Markdown tool is a writing app with a preview pane. MuM is the opposite: a native macOS reader with no web engine inside — all AppKit. Several projects open at once, each remembering where you stopped. Cross-project search. Typesetting tuned for CJK as well as Latin. ~0.3s cold start, 1.7 MB download, 100+ fps scrolling a 5 MB document. Open source, MIT.

products.name: Lattice
products.tagline: Reshape your text across languages while preserving meaning
products.description: Lattice reshapes your text through multiple language paths, creating a fresh expression while preserving the original idea.

products.name: vantage.ai
products.tagline: See and control what your coding agent does.
products.description: Vantage is a free, open-source cost and usage monitor, guardrail and session log for coding agents.
